name: fill rules
description: Nested squares 100x100 / 50x50: non-zero with equal orientation fills the hole (10000), even-odd or opposite orientation leaves it (7500). fill-rule is inherited and settable from CSS.
svg: <path id="nz" d="M 0 0 H 100 V 100 H 0 Z M 25 25 H 75 V 75 H 25 Z"/>
<path id="eo" fill-rule="evenodd" transform="translate(110 0)" d="M 0 0 H 100 V 100 H 0 Z M 25 25 H 75 V 75 H 25 Z"/>
<path id="rev" transform="translate(220 0)" d="M 0 0 H 100 V 100 H 0 Z M 25 25 V 75 H 75 V 25 Z"/>
<g fill-rule="evenodd"><path id="inh" transform="translate(330 0)" d="M 0 0 H 100 V 100 H 0 Z M 25 25 H 75 V 75 H 25 Z"/></g>
<path id="css" class="eo" fill-rule="nonzero" transform="translate(440 0) scale(0.5)" d="M 0 0 H 100 V 100 H 0 Z M 25 25 H 75 V 75 H 25 Z"/>
